name: File Weaver Community Library
description: Official presets and rules for File Weaver, maintained by Sprocket Consulting.

entries.name: Photo Cleanup
entries.description: Normalises camera filenames: strips IMG_ prefixes, reformats compact dates to YYYY-MM-DD, lowercases, trims spaces.

entries.name: Podcast Episodes
entries.description: Numbers files sequentially as a prefix (001-, 002-, ...) and lowercases the name for consistent episode filenames.

entries.name: Truncate Long Names
entries.description: Script rule that shortens names longer than 40 characters and trims whitespace.
